_meta._note: S213b re-verification round-1: S213 findings that had primary scores but were skipped for volume. DALPHIN (pathology copilot: PathChat+/Gemini-2.5-Pro/GPT-5), PANDA-PLUS-Bench (Gleason cross-slide robustness: HistoEncoder/Virchow2), MedR-Bench (DeepSeek-V3.2/Qwen3.5-35B diagnosis+treatment), Biosignal M2AE (wearable ECG-PPG CVD/hypertension AUROC), Astra (3D CT RRG FORTE/RadBERT). SKIPPED due to benchmark-id COLLISION: RadImageNet-VQA (existing radimagenet_vqa is a different bench, radfm 79.5/meddr 84.2) and generic forte bench (different FORTE). x100 applied to 0-1 metrics.

benchmarks.name: DALPHIN — Diagnosis Semantic Similarity (BioBERT)
benchmarks.description: Multicentric open pathology-copilot benchmark (1,236 images/300 cases/14 subspecialties). Diagnosis BioBERT semantic similarity vs pathologists (DALPHIN, arXiv 2605.03544). Higher is better.

benchmarks.name: PANDA-PLUS-Bench — Cross-Slide Gleason Accuracy
benchmarks.description: Prostate-Gleason cross-slide robustness of pathology FMs (PANDA-PLUS-Bench, arXiv 2512.14922). Measures generalization without slide-artifact leakage. Higher is better.

benchmarks.name: MedR-Bench — Diagnosis
benchmarks.description: Clinical reasoning benchmark, diagnosis sub-score (MedR-Bench, via GSEM arXiv 2603.22096). Higher is better.

benchmarks.name: MedR-Bench — Treatment
benchmarks.description: Clinical reasoning benchmark, treatment planning sub-score (MedR-Bench, via GSEM arXiv 2603.22096). Higher is better.

benchmarks.name: Wearable CVD 5-Class AUROC (ECG-PPG)
benchmarks.description: 5-class cardiovascular disease classification AUROC from paired ECG-PPG signals (Biosignal M2AE, arXiv 2605.09579). Higher is better.

benchmarks.name: Wearable Hypertension Detection AUROC (PPG)
benchmarks.description: Hypertension detection AUROC from wearable PPG (Biosignal M2AE, arXiv 2605.09579). Higher is better.

benchmarks.name: CT-RATE FORTE (3D CT report gen)
benchmarks.description: FORTE fine-grained diagnostic report metric on CT-RATE chest CT report generation (Astra, arXiv 2605.31437). Higher is better.

benchmarks.name: CT-RATE RadBERT (3D CT report gen)
benchmarks.description: RadBERT semantic metric on CT-RATE chest CT report generation (Astra, arXiv 2605.31437). Higher is better.
